<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-04-0422-45-49" status="unreviewed">yang <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs>
               <lb n="46a3"/>na re rtags chos can gyi phyogs 1 la ma grub pa phyogs chos kyi skyon ma yin te | sgra la mi rtag pa khyab byed du sgrub pa la rtsol byung rten tsam du bkod na khyab pa la rten pa'i skyon yin gyi phyogs chos skyon med yin la | rtsol byung khyab byed du bkod na ngo bo ma grub pa gyi dur ma 'dus pa'i phyogs 1 la ma grub pa'i skyon du ma song ste rtsol byung sgra
               <lb n="46a4"/>la khyab byed du yod pa shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir | rtags kyi phyogs 1 chos can la ma grub pa yang mi srid de sgra mi rtag par bsgrub pa la sgra dang sgra ma yin gyi byas pa tshogs pa rtags su bkod na ya khyal bkag na tshogs pa khegs pas rtags kyi ngo bo ma grub par 'dus pa'i phyir | so sor rtags su bkod na sgra'i byas pa grub pa kho na yin sgya ma yin
               <lb n="46a5"/>gyi byas pa ma grub pa 'ba' zhig yin pas phyogs 1 ma grub par mi <expan>'gyur ro</expan> | tsam ldog gtan tshigs su bkod na yang ma grub pa'i cha med pa'i phyir | yang de 2 mtshungs pa yang ma yin te tshogs pa gtan tshigs su bkod na phyogs chos skyon can du yang 'gyur ba yin yang khyal bkag pas tshogs pa khegs pa'i phyir dper na sgra ma yin gyi
               <lb n="46a6"/>byas pa bkag pas byas pa <expan>thams cad</expan> tshogs pa khegs pa bzhin | tshogs pa chos can du bzhag pa'i cshe phyogs chos kyi skyon du mi 'gyur ba yang yod de ya khyal la bkag pas tshogs pa la mi khegs pa'i phyir | dper na dud 'gro <expan>thams cad</expan> khegs pa la nog shal laso pa 'das pas pa lang gi tha snyad sgrub pa bzhin | tsam ldog rtags su bkod pa dang chos
               <lb n="46a7"/>can du bkod pa'i tshe yang mi mtshungs te sgra la byas pa tsam ldog rtags su bkod na skyon med yin la dud 'gro tsam gyi rdzas chos can du bzhag pa la nog shal lasogs pa bkod pa'i tshe phyogs 1 la grub kyang | rta lasogs pa dud 'gro'i phyogs 1 la ma grub pa'i phyir zhes zer |</seg></TEI>
